reason: The plugin is primarily an event-notification integration for dsh-TUI, sending long-turn completion and approval-request alerts to IM webhook platforms (Feishu/DingTalk/WeCom/generic) and providing `/webhook` commands for status/test and `/settings`-based configuration, indicating a communications/notifications use case rather than code-editing or analytics features.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 dsh-TUI 中将长轮次完成和审批请求事件推送到飞书、钉钉、企业微信或通用 webhook，并通过 `/webhook` 与 `/settings` 进行状态查看和配置。
summaries.en: This plugin sends dsh-TUI long-turn completion and approval events to Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, or generic webhooks, with `/webhook` status/test and `/settings` configuration support.

capabilities: Reads webhook URL and optional signing secret from local dsh settings
Sends outbound HTTP POST notifications to configured webhook endpoints
Exposes commands to show webhook status and send a test notification
